body:
TEMPORARY CONTROLLING DIRECTION (Greg, 2026-11-02 ~00:06Z, in his acting chat, quoted verbatim on Engram note 2016df8c53864edfad041ba7d6c0caff and relayed by Engram::Architect3 in TermAl mailbox 63096d00 #464): 'Engram::Fable sie zatkal czekajac ma moj input TO NIE JEST ACEPTOWALNE independent acceptance evaluation first, THIS SHIT IS TURNED OFF UNTIL WE GOT THIS WORKING'.

POLICY STATE (revision 2, per Architect3 #466 and #467): both live project stores, Engram and TermAl, now have independent-evaluator enforcement OFF. Readback shows acceptance_evaluation.allowed_modes=[], mechanical_basis=asserted, source_freshness=false, epoch 3. TermAl's policy is e83a04e54c034d81b9bd6f1bbf93e6fb, authority dcfd8dc4272745c4a1958bdcdf10d48f, activated 2026-11-02T00:07:54Z, with the operator recorded as Engram::Architect3 on Greg's word.

TermAl application:
- An independent acceptance evaluation is NOT a precondition for landing or for completing an item. Self-asserted completion is supported and active.
- An item stays pending ONLY for criteria or bindings it has not actually met (for example a test-bound criterion without a host-recorded passing check, or a runtime criterion not yet observed). It does not stay pending merely because no independent evaluator ran.
- No evaluator verdict is fabricated; an absent verdict stays absent.
- This is the named temporary exception to CLAUDE.md commit-rule condition 3's independent-evaluation clause, which is suspended while this lasts. It is NOT a new blanket commit or push permission: every other standing condition still applies (the review pair, the exact-tree FULL, real criterion evidence, integration-owner checks, schema and cutover rules, and Greg-only restart).
- Do not re-enable enforcement on an install or restart.
- Separate from model-turn gating, which also stays OFF.
Retire this when the evaluation mechanism works again (tracked by w-fdbb4fb85a50) and Greg or the coordinators restore it. Any permanent cleanup of the instructions is proposed separately.
